title: Hidden-ensemble leakage-aware robust GRAPE
difficulty_explanation: A nominal or mean-risk pulse is insufficient: the submitted qutrit pulse must suppress leakage and coherent error over secret coupled perturbations while obeying hard endpoint, amplitude, and slew constraints.
solution_explanation: The expert uses TensorCircuit QuditCircuit propagators and exact JAX reverse-mode gradients, a composite-pulse warm start, a deterministic nested 83-member uncertainty grid, continuation from mean loss to a smooth tail loss, and a final global contraction that guarantees the drive and slew limits.
verification_explanation: An independent SciPy matrix-exponential oracle evaluates the pulse on hidden seeded interior members and every uncertainty-box corner, then enforces fidelity, leakage, and hardware constraints.
conditioning_notes: The projected computational-block fidelity is global-phase invariant. Leakage is evaluated independently because a good nominal trace overlap can hide population outside the computational subspace. Sparse axis anchors do not control coupled box corners.
api_risks: Requires differentiable tensorcircuit.QuditCircuit.unitary, QuditCircuit.matrix, tc.gates.Gate, and the JAX backend expm in the pinned TensorCircuit-NG image. The expert fixes complex128 to avoid threshold-scale drift.
claim_boundary: A fresh v6 protocol froze the exact expert, evaluator, image digest, resources, command template, and 4+8 public cases before execution; all twelve direct expert runs passed and an independent read-only audit reconstructed the preserved raw evidence. The tracked canary record is sanitized branch-portable evidence, while the complete raw bundle remains local, ignored, unsigned custody. This is public trusted-expert feasibility only, not private prequalification, Harbor evidence, hostile-model isolation, human approval, or model-hardness evidence.

operator_observed_v5_development.audit_scope: Independent GO applied to trusted expert-only evaluator execution, not to evidence provenance. Missing immutable pre-run plan bytes and raw logs prevent any validation claim; mutable transitive globals and seed-derived holdouts also prevent hostile model isolation.

admission_blockers: The v6 record is a durable public trusted-expert feasibility result under local unsigned custody, not private expert prequalification, canonical Harbor evidence, human approval, or model-hardness evidence. The earlier v5 runs remain unpreserved operator observations only.

The hidden interior stream is derived from the same base seed that generates solver-visible configuration state, including optimization_seed modulo 2**31 - 1. Before any solver trial, use an independent verifier-only hidden seed/key or an isolated precomputed holdout artifact that is not derivable from the public config.

The evaluator binds trusted direct callables before import but runs in process and retains mutable transitive globals. Its audit GO is limited to trusted expert-only revalidation, not hostile model isolation.

The historical 25-case private screen tested the older d1d8e9ba expert, stopped at its first failure after 22 passes, and left its final two cases intentionally unrun; none of those cases may be rerun or substituted.

After the hidden-seed and isolation redesign, re-audit and hash the complete task revision, freeze a fresh private schedule, pass private expert prequalification, and obtain renewed human review before any model campaign.
Concept, prototype, pilot, authorization, and two-auditor model-hardness gates remain unsatisfied; no model trial is authorized.

seed_protocol.base_seed_mapping: The base seed generates public uncertainty widths and pulse parameters; base_seed XOR 0x5A17C3 initializes the current 48-point held-out interior stream, while all eight corners are enumerated. This deterministic relationship is acceptable only for trusted expert feasibility and must be replaced before any solver trial.
seed_protocol.public_optimization_seed: optimization_seed is intentionally present in the solver config as base_seed modulo 2**31 - 1 for solver-local randomness; it is public and must not be treated as a verifier-only secret.
seed_protocol.model_privacy_requirement: Before any solver trial, hidden holdouts must use an independent verifier-only seed/key or an isolated precomputed artifact not derivable from solver-visible configuration state.
seed_protocol.determinism_scope: The exact public control config is deterministic under the pinned runtime and is identified by the evaluator-emitted case_digest; hidden held-out members and oracle metrics are excluded.
seed_protocol.case_identity: SHA-256 of canonical JSON with sorted keys, compact separators, and ndarray/scalar normalization over the exact public config; functional stdout emits the full case_digest and protocol_seed in one structured orbit_q_case_identity JSON line.
seed_protocol.pinned_numpy_note: The target image pins NumPy 2.2.6 and SciPy 1.17.1; a seed alone is not a cross-runtime case identity, so trial manifests must bind the image/runtime and case_digest.
